tier_reason: Lowered A to C: the enricher read the search-benchmark-game harness behind the numbers and found correctness bugs in the PISA engine driver (do_query.cpp seeds block-max WAND with per-term top-10 thresholds for TOP_100/TOP_1000, so union top-k returns fewer than k docs; intersection_union and negated queries are mis-parsed; all 59 COUNT results differ from Lucene). Numbers measured on a harness that returns different results from the baseline do not meet A or B; on the clean subset the result is mixed (TOP_10 0.94x Lucene 10.4.0, intersection TOP_1000 1.34x, union COUNT 0.36x, derived from page data). Kept and documented per the keep-and-document rule.

corrections.claimed_speedup: search-benchmark-game (PISA 0.8.2 vs Lucene 10.4.0, Ryzen 7 9800X3D), clean subset only (derived from page data): TOP_10 on 601 intersection+union queries 0.94x Lucene, 0.73x lucene-bp, 1.34x Tantivy 0.26; intersection TOP_1000 1.34x Lucene; union COUNT 0.36x. The headline geomean 2.19x TOP_1000 rests on union queries that return fewer than k docs and on COUNTs that differ from Lucene, so it is not valid.
corrections.caveats: Harness bugs in engines/pisa-0.8.2/tools/do_query.cpp invalidate the union TOP_100/TOP_1000 and COUNT rows; the harness builds block_simdbp (SIMD-BP128), not FastPFOR. Benchmarked v0.8.2 (2021); current v0.10.0.
